verticalcut.crt.no_slots: This CRT has no module slots
verticalcut.crt.pouch.none: No coal pouch (put a bundle in the slot)
verticalcut.tooltip.stone_crt.shows: Shows caves, water and lava, but no ores.
verticalcut.tooltip.stone_crt.picture: Crude: the picture lags behind and flickers now and then.
verticalcut.tooltip.copper_crt.shows: Shows ores in black and white.
verticalcut.tooltip.copper_crt.upgrade: Upgrade on the smithing table with a torch and an Iron Picture Tube.
verticalcut.tooltip.iron_crt.shows: Shows ores in color, and twice as far: 64 by 64 blocks.
verticalcut.tooltip.iron_crt.picture: Steady picture without flicker of its own.
verticalcut.tooltip.iron_tube.use: Turns a Copper CRT into an Iron CRT on the smithing table, with a torch as template.
verticalcut.tooltip.crt.coal: Eats coal or charcoal from your inventory, one per %s seconds of scanning.
verticalcut.tooltip.crt.slots: Module slots: %s. Sneak + right-click to open.
verticalcut.tooltip.crt.pouch: A bundle in a slot is a coal pouch: the CRT then eats only from it, anything a furnace burns.
verticalcut.tooltip.crt.finder: A bundle with an amethyst shard in it is a finder instead: put in anything made of an ore (raw ore, ingot, nugget, gem, dust) and that ore flashes in the picture. It never burns anything.
verticalcut.tooltip.crt.compass: A compass in a slot lets you lock the cut in the direction you look (%s). Its needle turns green with a clink when you face that way again. A lodestone compass points the cut at its lodestone.
verticalcut.tooltip.crt.spyglass: A spyglass in a slot lets you look deeper (%s): the picture then shows what lies below the normal one. You stand above it, a dotted line marks where.
verticalcut.tooltip.crt.lightning_rod: A lightning rod in a slot shields against most interference.
verticalcut.tooltip.crt.depth_gauge: A Depth Gauge in a slot shows Y levels in the picture.
verticalcut.tooltip.depth_gauge.use: CRT module: put it into a module slot to see Y levels along the edge of the picture.
verticalcut.tooltip.stone_crt.upgrade: Upgrade on the smithing table with a torch and a Copper Picture Tube.
verticalcut.tooltip.copper_tube.use: Turns a Stone CRT into a Copper CRT on the smithing table, with a torch as template.
verticalcut.config.title: Vertical Cut Settings
